review_candidates.title: Head of Strategy
review_candidates.description: Company Description FLIGHT (Foundational Learning Qualifications Who we are FLIGHT is a new and ambitious initiative, launched at the Africa Foundational Learning Exchange (FLEX2026) in Lilongwe in July 2026. Governments across sub-Saharan Africa are already leading bold reforms to improve foundational literacy and numeracy. FLIGHT connects Ministries of Education with tailored technical assistance that unblocks the bottlenecks slowing reform. Governments set the priorities. We help them go further and faster. Dakar, Nairobi or remote within sub-Saharan Africa · Full time, fixed term · Starting January 2027 As one of our first team members, you will help shape how FLIGHT works from the very start. The role We are looking for a hands-on Head of Strategy and Delivery to drive FLIGHT’s day-to-day delivery. You will work as a close partner to our Executive Director: she leads on strategy and relationships with the Board, funders and countries, and you make sure that strategy becomes results on the ground. You will start by delivering much of the work yourself, with scope to build a team as FLIGHT grows. What you will lead Delivery: plan and manage country engagements, tracking milestones and following up so commitments are met. Data and analysis: gather evidence on progress and results, and turn it into clear recommendations. Preparation: produce the briefings, Board papers and funder updates that keep FLIGHT moving. Relationships: work alongside governments, multilaterals, implementers and technical assistance providers. Quality: make sure technical assistance is well scoped and delivering results. What you will bring Hands-on delivery: you have personally delivered complex, multi-stakeholder programmes, not only overseen them. Education expertise: experience in education, ideally foundational literacy and numeracy. Government partnership: experience working with ministries, multilaterals or implementers in African contexts. Clear thinking: confidence with data, analysis and concise writing for senior audiences. Languages: English is essential. French or Portuguese is desirable. For more information about FLIGHT and the role, have a look here How to apply Submit your CV and cover letter. Answer a few short questions about your experience. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a screening call, followed by a written assessment and panel interview. Applications close on Friday 4 December 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage early applications. FLIGHT is committed to a fair and inclusive process and welcomes applicants from across Africa. Apply for this Job https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jobs.flight/dc17cd07-0ff3-4b12-bdf6-80e38e18005b

review_candidates.description: What's the role? We’re looking for a commercially minded and strategically rigorous Head of Growth to help shape the future of Australia’s leading digital lifestyle and news portfolio, including news.com.au, Taste, Escape, and Body+Soul. This is a high-impact opportunity for a leader who can combine the structured thinking of top-tier management consulting with the pace, pragmatism and execution focus of a high-growth digital business. You’ll help set the portfolio’s strategic direction, unlock new commercial opportunities and expand our reach across social, emerging platforms and strategic partnerships. About The Role Lead strategic planning across the digital portfolio, providing clear, data-led frameworks for major commercial, and growth decisions. Partner with commercial teams to identify new revenue opportunities and support the positioning and growth of advertising products and data assets across the portfolio. Lead strategic initiatives, market-entry opportunities and business development projects that diversify revenue and strengthen the portfolio’s market position. Define and execute the off-platform strategy across social media, third-party distribution networks and emerging digital platforms. Build scalable approaches to social distribution and creator ecosystems that grow brand authority, audience acquisition and monetisation. Work with Audience, Emerging Platforms, Marketing and Brand Product teams to improve the journey from off-platform touchpoints back to owned digital properties. Help maximise audience lifetime value, engagement and retention through an integrated, cross-platform growth strategy. Provide trusted strategic advice to the General Manager and influence senior stakeholders across the business and external platform partners. Who are you? You have experience in a top-tier management consulting environment such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Strategy& or Big 4 Strategy, with strong capability in problem-solving, strategic modelling and executive communication. You have since gained hands-on leadership experience in a high-growth start-up, scale-up or digital business, with a test-and-learn mindset and a bias towards action. You understand how to scale consumer touchpoints across media, technology or digital platforms, including social media distribution, creator networks or other off-platform channels. You bring strong commercial acumen and understand digital publishing economics, audience acquisition, social monetisation and data-led commercial models. You can combine strategic rigour with start-up agility, moving comfortably between high-level strategy and practical execution. You build trusted relationships with commercial teams, executive leaders and external partners across social, streaming and technology platforms. You are an energetic and credible leader who can mentor others and help foster a high-performance, growth-oriented culture. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact on portfolio strategy, commercial growth and audience expansion across some of Australia’s most recognisable digital brands. Why News Corp Australia Join a culture where innovation is our operating rhythm. You’ll work on a diverse portfolio of Australia’s most loved brands and play a pivotal role in leading the technological shift in how we create commercial content. Our vibrant, hybrid work environment and dynamic, values-driven culture empowers you to push boundaries, collaborate as one unified team, and make a positive, measurable impact for all Australians. News Extras Benefits is a commitment to our people for their valued contribution to News, our audiences, clients and communities. Our Benefits Include Exclusively ours - Access to publications and products from across the News Corp family Perks & discounts - Exclusive offers across a range of products and services that deliver genuine cost savings and benefits Health & wellbeing - Advice, support and facilities for healthy minds and bodies (including an onsite gym at our Adelaide, Brisbane & Sydney offices) Time off - News offers a range of leave options to support your personal needs and moments that matter in life: Parental leave, Birthday leave, Volunteer leave, Career break and Compassionate leave. Financial wellbeing - Support on making the most of your money Benefits In addition to our perks and benefits, employees have access to a number of initiatives and programs that support their wellbeing and professional growth, such as: Helping you grow - Access tailored development opportunities, including leadership programs, to cultivate your skills and support your career Giving back - Make a difference to our communities through volunteer opportunities and company-organised charity drives Workplace Inclusion and facilities – Engage with your passions through various employee-resource groups and accessibility to multi-faith quiet rooms & parents’ rooms Who are we? We are proud to be Australia's leading media company. For over a century, News Corp Australia has been an integral part of Australian life, delivering the news and information Australians rely on daily. Telling the stories that matter drives every piece of journalism, campaign, project, and innovation. With over 150 brands spanning news, sport, and lifestyle, we connect with 18 million Australians monthly - a testament to the trust we've built over generations. From text-based content to dynamic video, personalised apps, fantasy games, podcasts, and events, we continue to evolve to meet the changing needs of our audiences. Our purpose inspires us, and our five values guide how we achieve it: MAKE A DIFFERENCE - We are driven to create a positive, measurable impact. BE PRINCIPLED - We uphold integrity, acting with honesty and purpose. GET IT DONE - We are accountable for delivering high-quality outcomes. PUSH BOUNDARIES - We are courageous, bold, and forward-thinking. WORK AS A TEAM - We are one team, with many voices and diverse strengths. We are committed to telling the stories that matter, delivering value across every medium, moment, and minute Australians choose to spend with us. What’s next? Apply now or for more information on careers at News24 Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Diversity strengthens our national teams and newsroom as we seek to tell stories that represent the communities of Australia. Our people make us unique, and so we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability or gender identity. Applicants of diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply! We are committed to ensuring an accessible and supportive recruitment process. If you require any adjustments or accommodations at any stage, please do not hesitate to let us know here. In order for us to assist you, please ensure you include the role title you are applying for in the subject line. For more information regarding Diversity at NewsCorp Australia please visit www.newscorpaustralia.com/careers under the Diversity@News section. Category Free News & Lifestyle

review_candidates.title: Director Research Programs & Consortia
review_candidates.description: Are you a business-minded research professional with deep expertise in medical imaging who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment? Do you enjoy combining scientific and technical expertise with commercial understanding, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes? Collective Minds is looking for a Director, Research Programs & Consortia to drive our portfolio of public and private research collaborations. This is a broad, hands-on role with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact in a growing international healthtech company. About Collective Minds Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research. About the role As Director, Research Programs & Consortia, you will take responsibility for our portfolio of more than 10 public and private research consortia, which are a key part of Collective Minds' strategy and ongoing delivery. Working alongside CROs, biotech and medtech companies, pharmaceutical partners, academic hospitals and research organizations, these collaborations span medical imaging, big data, analytics, and AI modeling and validation across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research. Within these projects, Collective Minds acts as a data manager and platform provider, bringing deep expertise in medical imaging to support complex research collaborations. You will be responsible for successful project delivery, reporting and project close-outs, while coordinating project and research managers across our customer delivery organization. You will act as a playing coach andpersonally manage selected research consortia and contribute scientific and technical expertise when needed. This is a broad, hands-on role where you will combine scientific expertise with commercial understanding, set priorities and drive results through collaboration. You will ensure projects are delivered efficiently, within agreed scope and with a clear focus on quality and business value. Your main responsibilities: Drive the research project portfolio, ensuring successful delivery within agreed budgets, timelines, scope and commitments. Coordinate project and research managers, aligning priorities, following up on progress and ensuring accountability across projects. Personally manage selected research consortia, including scientific, technical and operational activities. Provide scientific and technical guidance across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation. Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development. Manage budgets, project scope and stakeholder expectations, balancing scientific objectives with commercial priorities. Ensure accurate reporting to customers, funders and partners, including grant deliverables and efficient project close-outs. Collaborate with clinical and technical operations teams to plan capacity, resolve challenges and continuously improve project delivery. Who are we looking for? We are looking for a scientifically experienced and business-minded professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with a strong track record of delivering complex research projects. You are analytical, pragmatic and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, making decisions and finding effective solutions without adding unnecessary complexity. You communicate clearly, build trust with internal and external stakeholders and know how to balance scientific quality with business priorities and efficient execution. We believe you have: A strong scientific background in life sciences, medical sciences, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research. Experience from a commercial life sciences, medtech, biotech, pharma, CRO or healthtech environment, including scientific and academic collaborations. Proven experience managing complex research programs or consortia, including budgets, timelines, scope, reporting and project close-outs. Hands-on experience with research consortia, work package delivery, grant writing, grant execution and funding-related reporting. Strong technical skills, including scientific programming, analytical tools and data-driven research workflows. The ability to assess complex scientific and technical requirements, make informed decisions and contribute to technical implementations when needed. Commercial awareness and the ability to balance scientific objectives with budgets, resources and project commitments. Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive results across teams and external partners. A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt quickly and take initiative. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Willingness to travel internationally as required by research projects, typically approximately every two months. Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office. Why join Collective Minds? At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare. You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done. This is an opportunity to take responsibility for a strategically important research portfolio, work with leading scientific and industry partners and contribute to the continued growth of an international healthtech company. We look forward to receiving your application! We believe in a transparent and engaging recruitment process that gives both sides the opportunity to get to know each other. The process typically includes: Discovery call with recruiter Hiring manager interview Case study Leadership talk/ interview Reference checks If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Lotta Modin Jakobsson at lotta.modin@cmrad.com or +46 70 330 11 30.

review_candidates.title: Directeur
review_candidates.description: Directeur Netwerk Conceptueel Bouwen Bouw mee aan de toekomst van wonen in Nederland. Nederland staat voor een enorme woningbouwopgave. We moeten sneller bouwen, betaalbaar bouwen, duurzamer bouwen en tegelijkertijd de kwaliteit blijven verhogen. Dat vraagt niet alleen om meer woningen. Het vraagt om een fundamenteel andere manier van denken en samenwerken. Dat is precies waar Stichting Netwerk Conceptueel Bouwen (NCB) zich elke dag voor inzet. Vanuit een onafhankelijke positie brengt NCB partijen uit de volledige bouwketen samen om conceptueel ontwikkelen en bouwen verder te brengen. Inmiddels is NCB uitgegroeid tot hét landelijke netwerk waarin woningcorporaties, gemeenten, ontwikkelaars, beleggers, bouwbedrijven, toeleveranciers, ontwerpers, adviseurs en kennisinstellingen gezamenlijk werken aan de toekomst van de gebouwde omgeving. Na vele succesvolle jaren neemt de huidige directeur afscheid. Daarom zoeken wij een nieuwe directeur die voortbouwt op het sterke fundament dat is gelegd én die NCB helpt bij een volgende fase van groei, invloed en maatschappelijke betekenis. De organisatie en de strategische opgaven NCB is een unieke organisatie die bestaat uit een professioneel stichtingsbestuur, een krachtig ondernemend team en een indrukwekkend ledennetwerk. Het kernteam bestaat uit acht zelfstandige professionals, ongeveer vijf fte. Mensen met veel kennis, een groot netwerk en een sterke intrinsieke motivatie om de sector vooruit te helpen. Geen bureaucratie, geen managementlagen, wel ondernemerschap, eigenaarschap en veel energie. Zij zijn de drijvende kracht achter de kennisontwikkeling en kennisdeling rondom conceptueel ontwikkelen en bouwen en achter het florerende netwerk. De directeur fungeert als primus inter pares van dit team, stimuleert en kanaliseert de ongekende creativiteit en drive van dit team. Zij/hij heeft oog voor trends en geeft strategisch richting aan de koers van NCB en de te ondernemen initiatieven. Het netwerk van NCB is in vele opzichten uniek; de brede vertegenwoordiging en de gezamenlijke ambitie om de woningbouwopgave middels conceptueel ontwikkelen en bouwen te versnellen, zorgt voor een hecht en resultaatgericht netwerk. Dit netwerk is continu in ontwikkeling. Daar ligt ook jouw belangrijkste opdracht. Je verbindt bestuurders, beleidsmakers, corporaties, ontwikkelaars, bouwers, ontwerpers en kennisinstellingen rond de gezamenlijke ambitie en je bouwt het netwerk uit. De interesse vanuit decentrale overheden is groot; dat biedt kansen om het netwerk uit te breiden met provincies en gemeenten. Conceptueel ontwikkelen en bouwen is de toekomst om de woningbouwopgave te realiseren. De best practices zijn overtuigend en conceptueel bouwen ontwikkelt zich tot de norm. Als directeur stuw je de volgende fase door conceptueel ontwikkelen en bouwen op grote schaal in de praktijk van de grond te laten komen, door in te spelen op maatschappelijke vraagstukken waar conceptueel bouwen een oplossing voor kan zijn en door barrières te slechten. Je bent zichtbaar in de sector, bouwt bruggen tussen verschillende belangen en zorgt ervoor dat NCB dé plek blijft waar partijen elkaar vinden, inspireren en verder helpen. Wat ga je doen? Je bent het gezicht van NCB. Je vertegenwoordigt het netwerk aan bestuurstafels, tijdens congressen, in gesprekken met overheden en binnen de top van de Nederlandse bouw- en vastgoedsector en richting de leden. Je bewaakt de onafhankelijke positie van NCB en zorgt ervoor dat uiteenlopende partijen zich herkennen in de gezamenlijke agenda. Daarnaast: geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling van NCB; ontwikkel en verdiep je de relaties met professioneel opdrachtgevers, ontwerpers, conceptaanbieders, componentaanbieders en toeleveranciers; bouw je relaties uit met gemeenten, provincies, ministeries en landelijke stakeholders; stimuleer je de toepassing van bestaande kennis, standaarden en instrumenten; vergroot je de zichtbaarheid en impact van het netwerk; zorg je voor een gezonde financiële basis; inspireer en faciliteer je het ondernemende NCB-team. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken geen traditionele bestuurder, maar een ondernemend boegbeeld. Wij zoeken iemand die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen de bestuurskamer van een woningcorporatie, de kamer van een wethouder, een gesprek op een ministerie, een bijeenkomst met bouwondernemers of een werksessie met innovatieve conceptaanbieders. Je begrijpt hoe complexe samenwerkingen werken. Je ziet verschillende belangen, maar vooral ook de gezamenlijke kansen. Het bouwen en onderhouden van netwerken is een tweede natuur en uit zich in een breed netwerk. Ervaring en affiniteit met de verschillende geledingen in het netwerk bieden een groot voordeel. Je bent nieuwsgierig, toegankelijk en zichtbaar. Mensen zoeken je op, omdat je kunt verbinden, richting kunt geven en vertrouwen wekt. Je verbindt waar anderen polariseren. Je creëert beweging waar belangen vast lijken te zitten. En je gelooft dat de grote uitdagingen van vandaag alleen opgelost kunnen worden door samenwerking. Als dat je aanspreekt, dan is dit misschien wel de mooiste netwerkfunctie van Nederland. Je denkt positief en snel en acteert hands-on en resultaatgericht. Je houdt van de mentaliteit van een start-up, de professionaliteit van overheden en grote concerns en de drive van ondernemers. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Strategisch denker Je ziet ontwikkelingen aankomen, begrijpt wat er speelt in de markt en weet koers te houden in een complexe omgeving. Natuurlijke verbinder Je brengt mensen bij elkaar en creëert samenwerking waar anderen tegen grenzen aanlopen. Bestuurlijke sensitiviteit Je begrijpt hoe besluitvorming werkt binnen publieke én private organisaties en weet daar effectief in te opereren. Gezag zonder afstandelijk te worden Je bent een geloofwaardige gesprekspartner voor bestuurders en directies, maar blijft benaderbaar en authentiek. Ondernemend Je ziet kansen, neemt initiatief en weet ideeën om te zetten in concrete resultaten. Je houdt van bouwen Niet alleen aan woningen, maar vooral aan een team, aan netwerken, samenwerkingen en maatschappelijke verandering. Hands-on mentaliteit Je bent laagdrempelig benaderbaar en onderhoudt persoonlijk contact met toeleveranciers en (potentiële) leden, opent en presenteert op evenementen en online ledenupdates, etc. Wat breng je mee? Academisch werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring in een eindverantwoordelijke management-, directie- of bestuursrol. Ervaring met complexe stakeholderomgevingen. Ervaring met publiek-private samenwerking. Inhoudelijke kennis van conceptueel ontwikkelen en bouwen, met oog voor de hele keten, van gebied tot component en van uitvraag tot ontwerp. Ervaring met vraagstukken rondom wonen, vastgoed, gebiedsontwikkeling, bouw, duurzaamheid en/of maatschappelijke transities. Een bewezen trackrecord in netwerkontwikkeling en relatiebeheer. Ervaring met het verbinden van verschillende belangen rond een gezamenlijke ambitie. Wat bieden wij? Wij bieden je de unieke mogelijkheid om concreet bij te dragen aan één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke opgaven van Nederland: versnelling van de woningbouw. Wij bieden je ruimte om te ondernemen vanuit een onafhankelijke positie, midden in een netwerk van invloedrijke organisaties en bestuurders. En om samen te werken met een kernachtig, slagvaardig, hecht en zeer betrokken team dat elke dag laat zien dat impact niet afhankelijk is van omvang. Passend bij het ondernemende karakter van de NCB is de inzet als directeur opdrachtgericht (DBA-proof). Dat wil zeggen dat er een resultaatgerichte opdrachtformulering aan ten grondslag ligt en dat de inzet op basis van inhuur vanuit zelfstandig ondernemerschap plaatsvindt.
